**Phio invites individual and institutional investors as well as advisors and analysts, to attend online at[www.VirtualInvestorConference.com](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/bgMeOF00BB)**


King of Prussia, Pennsylvania–(Newsfile Corp. – October 6, 2026) – Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. (NASDAQ: PHIO), a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing cancer therapeutics based on its proprietary INTASYL® siRNA gene-silencing platform, today announced that Robert Bitterman, President and Chief Executive Officer, will present Phio’s INTASYL® siRNA therapeutic platform, its differentiated delivery approach, and the Company’s strategic direction at The Global Markets Virtual Forum hosted by www.VirtualInvestorConferences.com (VIC) on October 8th, 2026.


“The Global Markets Virtual Forum offers a unique forum to highlight Phio’s differentiated siRNA therapeutic platform, which is designed to enhance immune-cell function in solid tumors and has demonstrated a strong safety profile,” said Robert Bitterman, President and Chief Executive Officer of Phio Pharmaceuticals.


**Presentation Details:**


**DATE** : October 8th, 2026


**TIME: 12:40 PM (EDT)**


**LINK:**[Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. (NASDAQ: PHIO)](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/3KqnQIQQAv)


**Availability for 1×1 Meetings:** Robert Bitterman will be available for 1×1 meetings and can be scheduled with the link below:


**DATE** **TIME**


Thursday October 8, 2026 11:45 AM-2:15 PM (EDT)


Friday October 9, 2026 Noon – 4:30 PM (EDT)


Monday October 12, 2026 9 AM -1 PM (EDT)


**LINK for 1×1 meetings:**[Event Details](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/N3YkOSKK8z)


This will be a live, interactive online event where investors are invited to ask the company questions in real-time. If attendees are not able to join the event live on the day of the conference, an archived webcast will also be made available after the event.


It is recommended that online investors pre-register and run the online system check to expedite participation and receive event updates.


Learn more about the event at[www.virtualinvestorconferences.com](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/XEMYvIWWz7)


**About Virtual Investor Conferences®**


Virtual Investor Conferences (VIC) is the leading proprietary investor conference series that provides an interactive forum for publicly traded companies to seamlessly present directly to investors.


Providing a real-time investor engagement solution, VIC is specifically designed to offer companies more efficient investor access. Replicating the components of an on-site investor conference, VIC offers companies enhanced capabilities to connect with investors, schedule targeted one-on-one meetings and enhance their presentations with dynamic video content. Accelerating the next level of investor engagement, Virtual Investor Conferences delivers leading investor communications to a global network of retail and institutional investors.


**About Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp.**


Phio Pharmaceuticals Corp. (NASDAQ: PHIO) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing its proprietary INTASYL® siRNA gene silencing technology to eliminate cancer. Phio’s INTASYL compounds are designed to enhance the body’s immune cells to more effectively kill cancer cells. Phio’s lead clinical development program is an INTASYL compound, PH-762, that silences the PD-1 gene implicated in various forms of skin cancer. The Phase 1b trial (NCT# 06014086) evaluated PH-762 for the treatment of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma, melanoma and Merkel cell carcinoma. PH-762 is a potential non-surgical treatment for skin cancers.


For additional information, visit the Company’s website,[www.phiopharma.com](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/DOkrvuYYxN) .
